items.prompt: A 24-year-old adult Taiwanese woman with her natural fair skin tone, high cheekbones and a sculpted jaw, soft-glam makeup with a soft brown liner close to the lash line, long straight jet-black hair worn sleek and glossy with a deep side part. Curvy figure, 165 cm tall, bust 94 cm, waist 59 cm, hips 92 cm, F cup, full chest and slim waist. She wears a fitted ivory square-neck mini dress with thin straps, a slim gold chain necklace, small gold hoop earrings and nude pointed-toe heels. Setting: a quiet tree-lined lane in Taipei on a sunny afternoon in May, fresh green leaves overhead, a small café with a plain white wall and a wooden bench, a few potted plants, no signs or text, nobody else around. Moment: she stands facing the camera by the white café wall, holding a takeaway iced latte in one hand at her waist, and smiles softly, looking into the camera. Shot: waist-up, from a little above her head to just below her waist. Camera: vertical 3:4, at her eye level, level, an 85mm lens from about 2.2 metres, shallow depth of field, natural perspective. Composition: her face in the upper third, slightly left of centre, the white wall and soft green leaves behind her. Light: she is in the open shade of the trees, the bright open sky in front of her lighting her face softly and evenly; sunlight falls on the leaves and the lane behind her; fresh green, ivory, warm skin tones and soft gold. Natural skin texture with visible pores, believable light that belongs to the scene, refined colour grading.
